description: This file appears to be an HTML document that hosts a code editor showcasing the Tcl language mode implementation for CodeMirror. It includes a sample Tcl script within a textarea, along with scripts and stylesheets for rendering and syntax highlighting. The primary content is the embedded Tcl source code used for an IRC 'whois' script.
